params.title: Session ID
params.description:
Identifier used to load and separate conversation history. If provided, the agent will include the corresponding conversation history in the context. If empty or omitted, each request will be treated as a new session without history.
For example, this can be a chat ID or a user ID to distinguish different conversation threads.

params.title: Force Think Tool
params.description: If enabled, the agent will always use the Think tool to write its reasoning, intermediate thoughts, or notes between main tool calls. It's recommended to connect only one Think tool to the agent.

params.title: Context Window Length
params.description: Specifies the number of most recent message pairs (user and assistant) to include in the context window passed to the LLM. Increasing this value allows the model to consider a longer conversation history, which can improve coherence, but may also consume more tokens and affect performance.

params.title: Max Iterations
params.description: Defines the upper limit of tool invocations allowed for the LLM agent in a single reasoning process. If this threshold is reached, the agent will halt execution and respond with a message indicating it was stopped due to reaching the maximum iteration count.

params.title: Temperature
params.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

params.title: Max Tokens
params.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion

params.title: Structured output
params.description: When enabled, the LLM will be forced to respond in JSON format. You should define the expected JSON structure and formatting rules in the prompt or in "Output JSON Schema"

params.title: Output JSON Schema
params.description: When specified, this JSON Schema defines the exact structure, types, and constraints of the expected JSON output from the LLM. The model will be guided to strictly follow this schema during generation. Example: `{ "name": "output_schema", "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "output": { "type": "string", "description": "Provide output here" } } } }`. You can read more info and generate schema [here](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs).

params.title: Chat ID
params.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g., 1035597319) or the username of the target public chat (in the format @channelusername or @supergroupusername). For example, if the group's public link is t.me/mygroup, the username is @mygroup. You can find the Chat ID in the "List Chats" node.

params.title: Text
params.description: If your message exceeds 4096 characters, it will be automatically split into multiple parts. This only works if the "Parse Mode" field is set to "Plain Text".

params.title: Parse Mode
params.description:
You can use bold, italic, underlined, strikethrough, spoiler text, block quotations as well as inline links and pre-formatted code in your bots' messages. You can specify text entities directly, or use markdown-style or HTML-style formatting, [read more](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options).

For formats other than `Plain Text`, the message text **must comply with the rules** of the selected format.

params.title: Original Message ID
params.description: If provided, the new message will be sent as a reply to this message

params.title: Reply Markup
params.description: Enter additional interface options that are a JSON-serialized object including an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots#inline-keyboards-and-on-the-fly-updating), a [custom reply keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots#keyboards), instructions to remove the reply keyboard or instructions to force a reply from the user, e.g. {"inline_keyboard":[[{"text":"Some button text 2","url":"https://botpress.org"}]]} or {"keyboard":[["Yes","No"],["Maybe"]]}. Note: keyboard cannot be used with channels. [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup) for more information.

params.title: Entities
params.description:
Enter a JSON-serialized list of [entities](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageentity), for example: [{"type":"bold","offset":0,"length":20}]. 
    This only works if the "Parse Mode" field is set to "Plain Text".

params.description:

Example: `{ "Name": "result.user.name", "Email": "result.contact.email" }`

params.title: Schedule cron
params.description:
Cron-выражение состоит из пяти подвыражений, разделенных пробелом: минута, 
час, день месяца, месяц, день недели. Узел позволяет запускать сценарий по cron выражению в выбранном часовом поясе. 
Обратите внимание: команда "Запустить один раз" не запускает сценарий по расписанию! Чтобы узел запускался по 
cron-выражению, сценарий должен быть развернут на prod окружении и быть в статусе "Активный". Чтобы отключить 
schedule-узел, можно деактивировать сценарий или удалить узел из сценария и развернуть 
обновленный сценарий на prod окружении.
